text:
claire: Noticed a repeat of the authz postmortem pattern — several services missing audit logs + a few tokens with TTL set incorrectly. Starting this thread to capture owners and a short timeline for remediation.

priyanka: I'll own an emergency sweep to rotate any tokens older than 45 days and add telemetry for failures. Aim: prototype script tonight, staging deploy tomorrow.

navid: I'll add an infra policy to fail manifests that don't include the `audit-logs/enabled: true` annotation. Will scope to prod namespaces first. PR by Tue.

olivia: Can someone draft the manual fallback runbook in case the rotator breaks? Who will be paged?

sam: I'll draft the fallback runbook and add oncall contacts. Manual steps will include how to revoke and re-issue tokens and a short checklist to notify downstream teams. ETA EOD tomorrow.

esther: I'll add CI/regression checks: (1) manifest linter rule for audit annotation, (2) an integration test that calls the introspect endpoint and verifies status after rotation. Target Fri.

priyanka: Quick helper cmd used to find tokens: `kubectl get secrets -A -l redwood/service-token -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}{"
"}{end}'` — sharing inventory to the channel shortly.

sec-bot: security: filed SEC-1044 "Rotation + audit-hook remediation" and linked incident-712. Priority: P2.

claire: Proposed metrics so we can monitor recurrence: percent services with audit-hook, weekly tokens rotated, and failed-introspections per day. Can we add that to the dashboard?

priyanka: Yes — adding telemetry events for `rotation.success`, `rotation.failure`, and `audit_hook.present`. Will share dashboard link once populated.

navid: Admission policy WIP — adding exception list for infra-managed legacy services. Will post PR for review.

sam: noted. I've created a short milestone on the remediation board and assigned owners. Weekly check-ins until the dashboard shows >95% audit-hook coverage.

olivia: Scheduling a quick sync Thu 11am PT to confirm blockers. If PRs slip, we'll execute Sam's fallback runbook. Thanks all :thumbsup:

priyanka: PR opened for rotator: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/rotator/pull/13 — requesting reviews from @esther and @navid.

esther: Reviewing now. Quick note: ensure rotator respects active sessions and supports dry-run mode.

claire: Great — post updates here if anything blocks the Thu sync.
